critical_code_review_comments: server.py is ~1029 lines — consider splitting into modules (auth, admin, payments, subscriptions, booking) for maintainability.

In /api/auth/reset-password, find_one_and_update sets used=True but the response check does not verify the token document was actually returned before proceeding — this is currently fine because find_one_and_update returns None when no match, but adding a comment/explicit check would improve clarity.
Login attempts counter is not reset on successful password reset — actually it IS reset via delete_many on email in reset_password (good).

AppointmentEditBody in models still uses singular service_id while appointments now use service_ids list; admin update endpoint /admin/appointments/{id}/status only takes StatusBody so no bug, but AppointmentEditBody appears unused — dead code.
